newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen firm after record high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen firm after record high.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be steady on Tuesday after the index closed at a record high on Monday but possible profit-taking would limit any further rises, brokers said.
"The potential upside is still on as some blue chips and medium-sized stocks are considered cheap," a broker with London-based securities firm said.
He also said continued speculative interest on some stocks such as Bakrieland and Bukaka might boost sentiment in secondaries.
Bakrieland on Monday topped the active list on talk it would be involved in the construction of a mass rapid transportation project, brokers said.
Brokers said the debut of medium-sized Bank Bahari BARI.JK could also help overall sentiment.
"But profit-taking in some counters might prevent the index from a sharp increase today," a broker with a Singapore-based firm said.
On Monday, Jakarta stocks ended up 1.08 percent at a record 724.56 points on the back of continuing strong fundamentals in the economy, brokers and analysts said.
